concept_updates.description: A collection of performance goals, including a SMART performance goal set.
A count used to specify how many members a collection contains, such as ten goals.
A proportional numeric value expressed as a percentage, such as 10%, 15%, or 20%.
A method used to carry out work, with observed examples including Pandas apply and targeted outreach.
A software-based operational system, exemplified by a digital work-order system.
A collection of training subjects, such as customer service, conflict resolution, and fair housing.
A collection of goal constraints such as concrete metrics, deadlines, and verifiable outcomes.
A callable software function, exemplified by make_hyperlink.
A named function input parameter, exemplified by value.
A string template used to construct a relative path, exemplified by ./{}.
A formula interpreted by spreadsheet software, exemplified by the HYPERLINK formula.
A value used as an illustrative function input, exemplified by example.
A concrete formula expression value, exemplified by a HYPERLINK expression.
Software that interprets formulas in the observed usage, specifically spreadsheet software.
A link rendered as a clickable object in spreadsheet software.
A structured data container, exemplified by a DataFrame.
A named column in a tabular data structure, such as Value or Hyperlink.
A string-valued software result, exemplified by a hyperlink formula string.
A proposition subject to support or contradiction, such as the claim that fixed learning styles strongly affect learning.
Information used to evaluate a claim, exemplified by research evidence.
A proposed category of learner preference, exemplified by auditory learner.
An educational practice, with teaching as the observed example.
A method of instruction, exemplified by multimodal teaching.
An observed learner outcome or behavior, exemplified by actual student performance.
A condition affecting a learner, exemplified by learning difficulty.
A difficulty associated with a particular domain of learning.
A learner capability discussed as something that can develop.
An educational support intervention, exemplified by early identification.
A factor that contributes to learning, exemplified by memory.
An outcome of learning activity, exemplified by successful learning.
An air-travel itinerary, with a round trip as the observed example.
A city used as a flight origin or destination, exemplified by New York City.
A day number within a calendar month, exemplified by the nineteenth.
A directional segment of a trip, exemplified by the outbound leg.
A preference over travel timing, exemplified by departing as early as possible.
A preference over price, exemplified by choosing the cheapest option.
A candidate flight itinerary, exemplified by a lowest-price round-trip option.
A pattern describing flight stops, exemplified by one stop.
A clock time without a full calendar date, such as 00:30 or 18:00.
A date-time expressed relative to another date, such as 07:35 the next morning.

operator_updates.description: Relates a software command to the software object or interface in which it is available.
Relates a software command to the signal-processing method it implements.
Relates a signal-processing method to an acoustic parameter used to configure it.
Relates an experimental stimulus set to an acoustic parameter checked in its results.
Relates a professional role to the organization in which that role is situated.
Relates a goal set to the requested number of goals it contains.
Expresses that a goal or goal set covers a collection of performance or training topics.
Relates a performance goal to its percentage target.
Relates a goal to the time window by which it is to be completed.
Represents accepting either a software parameter or a social role in the observed samples.
Represents a function constructing a relative path from a path template in the observed usage.
Relates a path template to the parameter used to format it.
Relates a function to a returned formula or string value, making the operator generic over return types.
Expresses that a spreadsheet formula uses a parameter value as displayed text.
Relates an example value to the function that receives it as input.
Expresses that spreadsheet software recognizes a concrete output as a formula value.
Relates a spreadsheet formula value to the hyperlink it renders as.
Represents containment across unrelated data, travel, and commerce domains in the observed samples.
Relates a processing method to the data column whose elements it iterates over.
Relates a processing method to the function it invokes for each element.
Relates a returned string value to the data column in which it is stored.
Relates a claim to evidence described as not supporting that claim.
Relates an educational practice to observations of student performance used to adjust it.
Relates a claim about fixed ability to capability information presented as contradicting it.
Relates a learner capability to an intervention described as supporting its development.
Relates a learning factor such as memory to a learning outcome it contributes to.
Expresses that a learning factor contributes to but does not uniquely determine a learning outcome.
Represents a person requesting heterogeneous travel, commerce, or document tasks.
Relates a flight trip to its city of origin.
Relates a flight trip to its destination city.
Relates a trip leg to a relative departure date or calendar day.
Represents a person's heterogeneous timing or price preferences for flights.
Expresses that a flight option matches the user's lowest-price preference in the observed usage.
Relates a flight option to its stop pattern.
Relates a flight option to its departure time of day.
Relates a flight option to its relative arrival date and time.
Relates a flight option to its quoted monetary price.
Represents a person rejecting a flight option because its price is too high.
Relates a flight option to the user's assessment of its price.
Represents selection across flight, executor, and guardian decisions with heterogeneous argument types.

notes: All 40 concept IDs and 40 operator IDs from payload-002 are covered; no IDs were created.
Generic or overloaded operators such as contains, requests, accepts, returns, prefers, and selects intentionally have empty schemas.
Operator schemas use only names present in payload-002 concept_catalog.
